audience: Young Egyptian café-goers scrolling Reels/feed who already like iced matcha and want a treat worth trying
promise: BALACONBAR's iced matcha with coconut milk and boba looks and feels irresistible — your matcha moment
cta: Remember the drink and the brand: BALACONBAR — Your Matcha Moment / لحظتك مع الماتشا
direction: Contemporary product cinema first, heritage café second. Real cup (owner photo) is always the hero. Light: cool fresh → natural green → cream → gold → deep green. Type: El Messiri 500 (Arabic), Montserrat 500 tracked caps (English line only). Camera: one shared depth camera per scene (cinema.js + depth.js), rack focus and settle. Transitions: foreground occlusion (rope, pillar), focus handoff, match cut. Sound: warm 96 BPM Rhodes/pad score, ice + rope + one bell; hook → development → lift at 10 s → resolution at 17.5 s.
